archetype: Bento Grid (adapted) — modular cards, one idea per tile, calm and organized

primary.use: brand actions, active nav, primary CTAs

layout.sidebar: persistent left sidebar, 240px, grouped nav (Overview / Plan / Money / Growth / Health / Schedule), brand lockup at top, user menu at bottom, collapses to a drawer under 1024px
layout.dashboard: bento grid: unequal-sized rounded tiles, each one metric or module summary — never a uniform 3-col grid of identical cards
layout.dataPages: sticky-header tables with search + filter + status badges on desktop, collapsing to stacked cards on mobile
layout.forms: create/edit in a right-side slide-over panel, sectioned, inline validation, destructive actions confirm

components.statCard: surface card, rounded-xl, border, label in muted small-caps, large display-font number, optional trend delta in success/danger
components.badge: pill, 2px padding-y, semantic bg at 10% opacity + full-strength text of success/warning/danger/muted
components.button: primary = bg-primary text-primary-ink rounded-lg; secondary = border border-border bg-surface text-ink; ghost = text-ink hover:bg-surfaceMuted
components.icons: lucide-react, stroke-only, 18-20px, inline with text or left-aligned in nav — never inside a filled circle

imagery: no photography needed for an internal productivity app — rely on type, color, and data visualization (recharts) for visual interest
antipatterns: no emoji anywhere in the UI
no outline icon centered in a flat pastel circle
no uniform grid of identical icon-circle feature cards
no AI/chat/assistant UI of any kind — this product has none
